parent.negative: Shared degree2 structures fit quadratic known class but fail nonlinear carry

hypothesis: Learner infers per-output two-input Boolean operator truth tables and the roles of input bits from public FIT episodes, without receiving 21/211 affine/quadratic feature matrices or hidden operator identities; the learned transition can then carry binding state into unseen full causal trajectories.

frozen_sourcefree_families.synth_lut: Independent four-output-bit causal transfer laws: per-bit arbitrary two-input Boolean truth tables, each non-affine and dependent on two distinct public state/event bit positions, XOR one additional public bit. Separate hidden input wirings and truth tables per deterministic seed. Learned model sees only public FIT/CHECK/HELDOUT episodes; no truth table or wiring.
frozen_sourcefree_families.control_out_of_scope: Distinct source-neutral modular carry and role-conditioned three-input compositions not generable by any one two-input lookup XOR one raw bit. Must retain negative rather than overclaim.
frozen_sourcefree_families.source_public_features: 20 raw bits representing target current, target lag, source current, source lag, event

arms: learned shared 4 independent two-input Boolean truth tables with arbitrary learned wiring; deterministic exhaustive FIT consistency search; no source imports
independent equally informed and fully trained per-bit truth-table/wiring search with same complete raw 20 bit inventory and same 24 episodes; no candidate imports
fully trained source-target edge-specific truth-table/wiring search with same operator capacity but divided FIT examples among six bindings
previous frozen 211-feature quadratic model under exact original full public FIT, as a declared restricted reference
frozen fully trained gated BPTT recurrent control with same public FIT/CHECK
search_budget: Each bit searches every ordered a!=b and all raw z positions from 20 bits (20*19*20 = 7600 candidate wirings), constrains four lookup outputs entirely from FIT (no symbolic source), rejects inconsistent; choose first lowest canonical wiring and zero unconstrained lookup slots. A separate independently implemented full search competitor has same search budget.
learned_operators: Four unknown 4-entry binary Boolean truth tables; output XOR a learned raw-state/event third input bit; no ANF basis, no advance knowledge of each truth table or input wiring, only a generic small compositional program skeleton. This is bounded automatic lexicon induction, NOT unbounded cognitive operator discovery.
admission: FIT consistency all original supervised trajectories, CHECK all eight full autoregressive trajectories exact without labels fed back, no CHECK-driven retuning, then eight untouched positive and matched negative heldouts, zero hard false positives, abstentions tracked.
cost: Every (seed,family,arm) measured in separate complete Linux process; if feasible five repetitions for CPU/RSS; compare full process medians, do not declare equal FLOPs/resources without matched native work.
